settings.text: I don’t necessarily have dry hair but my hair is frizzy and this helps calm the frizz and makes my hair feel so soft. I use it after I blow dry my hair and so far love it. The smell isn’t bad but it’s fragrant in case those of you are sensitive to smell.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · I have no idea how this works so well, b
settings.text: I have no idea how this works so well, but it does. I love doing heartless curls overnight (Eternal Muse products are the best for this) and when I wake up, my hair looks pretty cute. Then I spray this witchcraft concoction and I suddenly—literally—look like I just walked out of the salon. Smooth, shiny, and the curls magically look 10x better?! I have used olaplex and all that, and this looks similar to when I’ve done a length olaplex treatment. Except that it’s just a quick spray. Not heavy, not greasy. Smell is a bit strong, but not bad, and I would saturate my hair with this even if it smelled like bad eggs. It’s that good.
Rated 5 out of 5
